criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Opened mesh uses the exact 12-vertex ground ring from Purdue BuildingShapes FID 218 / JNSN; largest nearest source-to-mesh ground vertex error is 0.00000982 m. OSM way 117146488 independently names Johnson Hall of Nursing and differs by 0.876 m Hausdorff.
criteria.uncertainty: Purdue polygon is not a certified structural survey; stored Shape__Area (1701.02 m²) conflicts with the local ring area (984.01 m²), though the OSM geometry corroborates the ring scale.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.status: verified against campus GIS; not survey-verified
criteria.evidence: The reopened mesh retains the projected campus coordinates and source polygon orientation without transformation from origin; GIS AABB is 42.40 by 42.72 m. Footprint vertices match the declared campus local approximation within 1 mm.
criteria.uncertainty: Projection is the repository's local approximation, and GIS/OSM wall-versus-edge semantics differ slightly; no independent survey dimensions were supplied. Overall mesh bounds include entry/plinth/parapet details.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS supports three levels. Reopened overall bounds reach 11.21 m, consistent with the documented nominal 11.25 m massing.
criteria.uncertainty: No dimensioned elevation or survey height was located. The 3.55 m floor-to-floor spacing and flat/parapet roof are builder assumptions; GIS Extrution=24 units are undocumented and are not valid height evidence.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The latest exterior, plan, and entry-elevation renders show three-storey punched openings, floor bands, a glazed entry, canopy and low parapet; object topology is present in the reopened mesh.
criteria.uncertainty: No exterior photo, facade elevation, or dimensioned plan supports the brick/limestone palette, regular opening pattern, west-facing entrance location, or roof parapet. The builder explicitly labels these provisional. Appearance is not source verification.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Directly opened the latest saved file (written at the same timestamp as the camera-only rebuild/renders). Expected scene and collection exist; one joined mesh, no modifiers, no linked libraries, and no unpacked external images. Raw sources, source record, source metrics, build script, and three valid PNG renders are present.
criteria.uncertainty: The master blend's single-link integration was outside this independent asset review.

evidence.version_compatibility_note: Opened read-only in Blender 4.5.15; Blender warned that the file was written by newer Blender 5.2. No save was performed.
sources_reviewed: Purdue October 2021 space report (29,742.28 sq ft)
Purdue nursing graduate handbook and university history timeline
Indiana Commission 2023 replacement project authorization and Purdue project page
evidence.master_link_check: not performed; evaluator examined standalone library only

findings.finding: The saved post-camera-change asset reopens successfully. The FID 218 shell geometry still matches the source ring to sub-millimeter vertex error.
This is a geometry-faithful GIS massing model, not a source-verified architectural reconstruction. Height and all facade/entry/roof details remain largely estimated.

The 2023 state authorization and current Purdue project page identify a planned replacement and proposed demolition. The evidence does not establish demolition completion at the present date; this asset is correctly scoped to legacy GIS identity, not the replacement.
